tickerText: [TENNIS] Barbora Krejčíková beats Olympic champion Qinwen Zheng 6-4, 6-4 to reach the Athens Open semifinals, while Gstaad and Bastad set Saturday semis — Tsitsipas faces Shevchenko and Rublev meets Vallejo • [SQUASH] Joachim Chuah and Rouqaia Othman sweep the HCL PSA Challenger titles in Chennai, with the Malaysian top seed beating Adham Roshdy and the Egyptian winning a five-game thriller over Hwayeong Eum • [BADMINTON] PV Sindhu snaps a five-match skid against Chen Yufei to reach the Japan Open Super 750 final — the Indian led 21-19, 15-10 when the Olympic champion retired with a hamstring injury • [PICKLEBALL] Day two at the Macon PPA Challenger brings gender doubles to Rhythm & Rally as 510 players from 37 states and 15 countries chase $10,000 across five pro divisions at the world's largest indoor facility • [TABLE TENNIS] Dempo Goa Challengers demolish Dabang Delhi 12-3 to match UTT's biggest win, Ayhika Mukherjee hands Sofia Polcanova her first Season 7 loss, and Mongolia's WTT Feeder opens Sunday after the Youth Contender wraps Saturday

newsItems.title: Krejčíková Stuns Zheng to Reach Athens Semifinals
newsItems.excerpt: Barbora Krejčíková defeated Olympic champion Qinwen Zheng 6-4, 6-4 in sweltering Athens heat to reach the WTA 250 semifinals. She will face Clara Tauson or Sara Bejlek for a spot in Sunday's final.

newsItems.title: Chuah and Othman Crowned Chennai Challenger Champions
newsItems.excerpt: Joachim Chuah beat Adham Roshdy 12-10, 11-7, 11-8 and Rouqaia Othman edged Hwayeong Eum in five games to claim the men's and women's titles at the HCL PSA Challenger in Chennai.

newsItems.title: Sindhu Into Japan Open Final After Chen Retires
newsItems.excerpt: PV Sindhu reached her first tour final in two years at the Japan Open, leading Chen Yufei 21-19, 15-10 when the Olympic champion retired with a hamstring injury. She will face Akane Yamaguchi or Putri Kusuma Wardani on Sunday.

newsItems.title: Macon PPA Challenger Doubles Day Underway
newsItems.excerpt: The 2026 Macon PPA Challenger continues at Rhythm & Rally with gender doubles on Saturday after 510 players opened the Georgia stop Friday. The event runs through Sunday at the world's largest indoor pickleball facility.
